title: Two-persona demo (CPV2-shaped)
description: Mirrors the shape of a real Case-Permissions-V2 demo — an admin (red) and a scoped user (green) in isolated sessions, with captions, pointer, highlights, live persona switching, and an assertion. Runs against public pages so it needs no login; point it at your app with --base-url and relative paths instead.
